steps.action: Archive or restore: Matter actions > Archive, Cancel, then Archive; archived controls and refusals
steps.expected: Cancel changes nothing; Archive keeps the M- reference and History, removes it from default lists, freezes ordinary changes (Status strip without Move to), and leaves children and the linked Contract unarchived.
steps.actual: Fixture: the Matter was closed again through the API (200). Matter actions > Archive opened "Archive DOC-032 compat compat-b matters admin lifecycle 1790579870201? The matter leaves the default list. Its history and M-number are kept. Cancel Archive"; Cancel left archivedAt null. Archive confirmed: header shows M-35 and "Archived"; Status strip reads "Open done In progress done Waiting done Closed" with 0 Move to buttons; Description textbox count 0; direct Description and Status writes answered 409 ("This matter is archived. Child M-36 archivedAt null; Contract C-109 archivedAt null.

steps.action: Archive or restore: find it with Show archived and Show closed, Restore Cancel, then Restore
steps.expected: Show archived alone does not list a closed archived Matter; adding Show closed does; Restore Cancel keeps it archived; Restore makes it editable and keeps it closed.
steps.actual: Filter > Show archived listed it: false; with Show closed added: true. Matter actions > Restore opened "Restore DOC-032 compat compat-b matters admin lifecycle 1790579870201? The matter returns to the default list and becomes editable again. Cancel Restore"; Cancel kept archivedAt 2026-09-28T07:18:01.612Z. Restore confirmed: archivedAt null, Status "Closed" (Category closed), 4 Status groups with Move to menus, Description saved (200).

steps.action: Before you start (negative): a Business User reads the Status in the Portal but cannot change, close, reopen, archive or restore
